spec.name: M7.ActualFactorized.numerator_record_count
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ (sector : M7.ActualFactorized.Outer N → Prop) (L R : Finset (ZMod N) → Prop), M7.ActualFactorized.numerator c sector L R = M7.ActualFactorized.recordCount c sector L R
spec.guidance: Use Factorized.numerator_record_card then actual toRecord bijection. Finset.card_bij transports actual records to triple coordinates. act projections reduce to leftImage/rightImage. Preserve arbitrary outer-sector and duplicate action images. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.ActualFactorized.stabilizer_numerator
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, M7.ActualFactorized.stabilizerNumerator c = M7.ActualOrbit.stabilizerCount c
spec.guidance: Use numerator_record_count with sector True and predicates equal to c.1/c.2; pair equality means both projected equalities. ExactTargetNumerator definition equals this numerator. Transport filter deciders using Finset.ext. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.ActualFactorized.translate_outer
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ g : M7.Action.Record N, M7.Action.act g c = M7.Action.act (M7.Action.translate g.leftShift g.rightShift) (M7.ActualFactorized.outerImage c (g.unit,g.exchange))
spec.guidance: Use reverse act_compose and show compose(translate s t)(unit/exchange with shifts0)=g via Record cases and simp compose/translate. Actual images, no abstract factorization hypothesis. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.ActualFactorized.sector_compatibility
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ E : M7.Action.Recipe N → Prop, M7.ActualFactorized.TranslationInvariant E → ∀ g : M7.Action.Record N, E (M7.ActualFactorized.outerImage c (g.unit,g.exchange)) ↔ E (M7.Action.act g c)
spec.guidance: Apply translation invariance to outerImage and rewrite translate_outer. This explicit compositional condition must later be discharged for actual signature sector; it is not a free final-M7 oracle. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.ActualFactorized.numerator_action_count
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ (E : M7.Action.Recipe N → Prop) (L R : Finset (ZMod N) → Prop), M7.ActualFactorized.TranslationInvariant E → M7.ActualFactorized.numerator c (fun u => E (M7.ActualFactorized.outerImage c u)) L R = M7.ActualOrbit.actionCount c (fun y => E y ∧ L y.1 ∧ R y.2)
spec.guidance: Rewrite numerator_record_count and use sector_compatibility under Finset.ext; direct unfolding actionCount/recordCount. No orbit enumeration in arithmetic numerator. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, 0 < M7.ActualFactorized.stabilizerNumerator c
spec.guidance: Rewrite actual stabilizer_numerator and use accepted ActualOrbit.stabilizer_positive. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M7.ActualFactorized.exact_orbit_quotient
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, ∀ (E : M7.Action.Recipe N → Prop) (L R : Finset (ZMod N) → Prop), M7.ActualFactorized.TranslationInvariant E → (M7.ActualFactorized.numerator c (fun u => E (M7.ActualFactorized.outerImage c u)) L R / M7.ActualFactorized.stabilizerNumerator c = M7.ActualOrbit.distinctCount c (fun y => E y ∧ L y.1 ∧ R y.2) ∧ M7.ActualFactorized.stabilizerNumerator c ∣ M7.ActualFactorized.numerator c (fun u => E (M7.ActualFactorized.outerImage c u)) L R)
spec.guidance: Use numerator_action_count and stabilizer_numerator then accepted ActualOrbit.exact_division. Parentheses explicitly enclose conjunction under hypotheses. Return tactic lines without leading by.
